endpoints.name: contacts_get_duplicate_contact
endpoints.description:
Get Duplicate Contact .

If `Allow Duplicate Contact` is disabled under Settings, the global unique identifier will be used for searching the contact. If the setting is enabled, first priority for search is `email` and the second priority will be `phone`. [GET /contacts/search/duplicate] Scopes: contacts.readonly.

number.description: Phone Number - Pass in URL Encoded form. i.e +1423164516 will become `%2B1423164516`

email.description: Email - Pass in URL Encoded form. i.e test+abc@gmail.com will become `test%2Babc%40gmail.com`

endpoints.name: contacts_create_association
endpoints.description: Update Contacts Tags Allows you to update tags to multiple contacts at once, you can add or remove tags from the contacts [POST /contacts/bulk/tags/update/{type}]

type.description: Path parameter "type", recovered from the URL template because the spec omits it.

contacts.description: list of contact ids to be processed

tags.description: list of tags to be added or removed

locationId.description: location id from where the bulk request is executed

removeAllTags.description: Option to implement remove all tags. if true, all tags will be removed from the contacts. Can only be used with remove type.

endpoints.description: Update Contact Please find the list of acceptable values for the `country` field here [PUT /contacts/{contactId}] Scopes: contacts.write.

tags.description: This field will overwrite all current tags associated with the contact. To update a tags, it is recommended to use the Add Tag or Remove Tag API instead.

dateOfBirth.description: The birth date of the contact. Supported formats: YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD-YYYY, YYYY.MM.DD, MM.DD.YYYY, YYYY_MM_DD, MM_DD_YYYY

endpoints.name: contacts_upsert_contact
endpoints.description:
Upsert Contact Please find the list of acceptable values for the `country` field here

The Upsert API will adhere to the configuration defined under the “Allow Duplicate Contact” setting at the Location level. If the setting is configured to check both Email and Phone, the API will attempt to ide… [POST /contacts/upsert] Scopes: contacts.write.

tags.description: This field will overwrite all current tags associated with the contact. To update a tags, it is recommended to use the Add Tag or Remove Tag API instead.

dateOfBirth.description: The birth date of the contact. Supported formats: YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD-YYYY, YYYY.MM.DD, MM.DD.YYYY, YYYY_MM_DD, MM_DD_YYYY

createNewIfDuplicateAllowed.description: Controls whether to create a new contact or update an existing duplicate. **Scenario 1:** If this value is `true` and the location allows duplicate contacts, a new contact will be created immediately without checking for duplicates. **Scenario 2:** If this value is `true` but the location does not allow duplicate contacts, this field is ignored and the normal upsert behavior applies: the API will search for an existing duplicate contact, update it if found, or create a new contact if not found. **Scenario 3:** If this value is `false` or not provided, the normal upsert behavior applies regardless of the location's duplicate contact setting. (default: false)
